phrases.english: The rest is all rubbish (of everything except a good heart)

phrases.latin: Pūrgāmenta forās effer; saccus plēnus est.
phrases.english: Take the rubbish out; the bag is full.

phrases.latin: Crās māne pūrgāmenta colliguntur: excipula forās effer.
phrases.english: The rubbish is collected tomorrow morning: take the bins out.

sources: Lewis & Short: quisquiliae · Lewis & Short: purgamentum

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. clean house, clean up, tidy up, broom: dustpan, garbage, trash, garbage can, waste basket. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 38, 39, 290, 292, 307, 320, 401, 404.
Cato, Livy, and Petronius from the Latinitas loci collections; Plautus as cited by L&S (edition spelling ecferte kept).
